description: Shared docs: Write a new version on top of base_version; a stale base is 409 doc_conflict with the current version. Free within your daily limit. Needs a hosted identity (create_identity).

base_version.description: the version you edited (the doc's current one)

max_cost.description: optional: your ceiling in credit; a higher price is refused, nothing spent. Default: the quote

request_id.description: optional retry key, unique among your commands: the same call again is never run or charged twice (the first answer within a minute, then 409 idempotency_conflict)

text.description: the new version's whole text, up to 64 KiB

title.description: a new title; default the current one

name: docs_write
title: Docs write
